Zoning envelope — Side yards: setback ratio 1:2, min 8 ft; rear 1:1, min 8 ft (§2-193). Drawn at the 30 ft maximum height; a lower wall may sit closer by the ratio. Floor area ratio, not lot coverage, limits bulk here; the FAR is a design check, not a line on the plan.
